description: This is a C# code-behind file for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named TakenCourses.aspx. It defines event handlers for button clicks that navigate to different pages within the online examination system.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: Partial class for the TakenCourses ASP.NET page, handling navigation button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load, currently empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the home button; transfers to Dashboard.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the profile button; transfers to UserProfile.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the leaderboard button; transfers to Leaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the logout button; transfers to LoginPage.aspx.
